notes: Three games over TTS (41 min total). Wildfire openings won 2 of 3 — whoever draws it early snowballs. Ash economy otherwise feels tight and interesting.

card_notes.note: Won 2/3 games on the back of turn-1/2 Wildfire. 40% of games this week ended by round two when it appears early.
card_notes.suggestion: Restrict to 1 copy in Standard rather than nerfing the card — burn should stay scary, just not consistent.

card_notes.note: Interaction with Ash Cloak prevention order was ambiguous at the table.
Only enables the Wildfire opening; fine on its own.

decisions.action: Publish standard-2026-07 restriction: Wildfire limited to 1
decisions.rationale: Two sessions of data; restriction preserves the archetype while killing the coin-flip opening.

decisions.action: Add ruling for Last Light + Ash Cloak ordering
decisions.rationale: Second timing ambiguity found by playtesters.
